# CATERPI11AR

> Caterpi11ar AI is a software studio that builds intelligent tools, bots, and libraries. We ship products that solve real problems — from smart travel maps to habit trackers to developer utilities. AI that evolves, built to last.

## Products

- [Locusify](https://locusify.caterpi11ar.com/): Smart travel tool that auto-generates visual route maps and highlight vlogs from photos. Extracts GPS data and timestamps to reconstruct your journey on an interactive map.
- [GIClaw](https://giclaw.cn): LLM-driven Genshin Impact agent that automates daily tasks via cloud gaming with visual AI. Uses vision models to understand game screenshots — no hardcoded coordinates. (原神视觉AI代理)
- [Dentic](https://github.com/caterpi11ar/dentic): Habit-building app designed to help users develop a consistent, lifelong brushing routine using scientifically-backed habit formation techniques.
- [Viper](https://viper.caterpi11ar.com/): Minimal Viper-inspired configuration library for TypeScript. Type-safe config management with Zod validation and JSON5 support for Node.js applications.
- [WeChat Chat Generator](https://wechat.caterpi11ar.com/): Free online tool that creates realistic WeChat chat screenshots. Customize sender, messages, and timestamps instantly — no app required. (微信聊天截图生成器)
- [Lark Imagine Robot](https://github.com/caterpi11ar/lark-imagine-robot): Open-source Lark/Feishu bot for AI-powered image generation and artistic creation. (飞书AI绘图机器人)
- [SRI Calculator](https://sexual.caterpi11ar.com/): Sexual Repression Index Calculator — a professional mental health assessment tool for measuring and evaluating sexual repression levels.
- [AI System Prompts Playground](https://ai.caterpi11ar.com/): Curated collection of 30+ AI coding tools' system prompts — Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI, Windsurf, Replit, v0, Perplexity, and more. Searchable and browsable.

## Philosophy

- **Evolve Constantly** — Products never stop improving. Every release is a step forward, never the final form.
- **Ship What Matters** — Focus on real value over feature count. Solve problems that users actually have.
- **Build to Scale** — Architecture that grows with demand. From prototype to production without compromise.
- **Open by Default** — Transparent processes, open-source foundations. Community-driven evolution.

## About

Caterpi11ar AI was founded in 2025 by Qin Dai. We are a remote-first, global team focused on product and engineering. Several of our products are open source and available on GitHub.

- Website: https://caterpi11ar.com
